backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV available on the signal date: VIXY, SPY, and QQQ daily return/range context plus stock resilience, liquidity, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20/ret60, and realized-vol fields. Paper entry is next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The volatility-stress resilient-leadership source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

gate_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: entry/candidate_pool: volatility-premium expansion with SPY/QQQ weakness may identify resilient stock leaders before the next session fully reprices defensive leadership.

2_history_check.exp-20260606-027: Macro stress resilient leadership failed with thin sample and negative EV; this uses observed VIXY volatility expansion across all days rather than only official event stress days.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-018/019: VIXY relief leadership was accepted; this is the mirror stress-resilience relation, not a threshold retune.
2_history_check.exp-20260607-021/022: UUP and crypto risk-on proxy leadership failed; this tests risk-off resilience rather than another risk-on beta proxy.

gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass.

hypothesis: VIXY volatility-stress days with weak SPY/QQQ may identify liquid resilient stock leaders whose next-open continuation beats cash without retuning the accepted VIXY relief adapter.
interpretation: The volatility-stress resilient-leadership source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer by retuning VIXY stress, SPY/QQQ weakness, stock resilience, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, the likely reason is that VIXY stress resilience is defensive beta, gets overwhelmed by risk-off continuation, or is too sparse after next-open execution and costs.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation; live activation would require closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping VIXY stress return, VIXY close-location, SPY/QQQ weakness, stock close-location, volume, ret20/ret60, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on the frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT volatility evidence, such as VIX term structure, options flow, realized-vol risk-transfer fields, or closed forward replacement-value rows from a shared default-off adapter.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source failed to add robust replacement value after next-open entry and costs. That suggests VIXY stress did not reliably separate durable resilient stock leadership from broad risk-off noise in the canonical windows.

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result would require a shared default-off adapter exposing the same VIXY/SPY/QQQ volatility-stress context, sector-known liquid stock universe, resilient-stock leadership fields, same-ticker core-overlap exclusion, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, cooldown, and concentration controls in both replay and daily production before any report queue, paper ledger, candidate priority, sizing, watchlist, or order surface could change.
